title: Monster Speed V3 Step 5 — Auto-merge + branch freshness
root_cause: Repository-level Auto-Merge and Update Branch are disabled. The connected GitHub App can manage PR content and enable auto-merge on an eligible PR, but it does not expose repository-administration writes for these two flags.
patch: Add a permanent fail-closed repository-settings guard to DevSystem so allow_auto_merge and allow_update_branch must stay enabled while preserving devsystem-final-gate, FAST PR certification, and FULL merged-main certification.

repair.patch: Remove merge-method availability from Step-5 blocking acceptance. Step 5 owns only allow_auto_merge, allow_update_branch, and preservation of the existing DevSystem final gate.
